title: When Should a Low-Light Pipeline Generate? Auditable Risk Control for Selective Generative Enhancement
abstract: arXiv:2610.21335v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Generative low-light enhancers recover plausible texture but may hallucinate structure; restoration networks preserve structure but can leave regions under-enhanced, and neither advantage is spatially uniform. Therefore, we formulate selective generative enhancement as a decision problem: determine where overriding a frozen base expert is beneficial and refuse to switch when the evidence is insufficient. We propose VetoNet, an auditable regional routing framework centered on a certified veto. It first measures the complementary strengths and routing direction of a frozen restoration generative pair, then predicts the utility of regional overrides from deployment-available signals alone and admits an override only when a distribution-free harm-budget certificate says the perceptual (LPIPS) risk budget allows it. Experiments across multiple expert pairs and domains show that VetoNet adapts its routing behavior to the strength and reliabi

translated_title: 低照度处理管线何时应该进行生成？面向选择性生成增强的可审计风险控制
translated_abstract: 生成式低照度增强器能够恢复看似合理的纹理，但可能产生结构上的幻觉；复原网络虽能保持结构，却可能导致部分区域增强不足，且两者的优势在空间上并非均匀分布。因此，我们将选择性生成增强形式化为一个决策问题：判断在哪些区域覆盖（override）冻结的基础专家模型是有益的，并在证据不足时拒绝切换。我们提出了VetoNet，一个以“认证否决”为核心的可审计区域路由框架。该框架首先测量冻结的复原专家与生成专家对之间的互补能力及路由方向，然后仅基于部署时可获得的信号预测区域覆盖的效用，并且只有当无分布假设的危害预算证书表明感知质量（LPIPS）风险预算允许时，才允许执行覆盖。在多个专家对和多个领域上的实验表明，VetoNet能够根据专家对的能力强弱和可靠性自适应地调整其路由行为。
tldr: VetoNet提出了一种以认证否决为核心的可审计区域路由框架，通过无分布假设的危害预算证书，在低照度增强中自适应地决定生成专家何时可以安全地覆盖冻结的复原专家，从而在控制感知风险的前提下实现结构与纹理的最优平衡。
en_tdlr: VetoNet proposes an auditable regional routing framework with a certified veto mechanism that adaptively decides when a generative expert may override a frozen restoration expert in low-light enhancement, using distribution-free harm-budget certificates to control perceptual (LPIPS) risk.
